findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed foods in the walk-in freezer stored directly on the ground. The PIC was educated that foods must be stored at least 6-inches above the ground. Ensure that foods are stored to protect against contamination by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.
